column5: 🎯 Propósito de la Tabla: This table contains financial statement data for OXXO stores, including information about the financial statement type, company, business unit, and consolidated financial statements. It appears to be used for tracking and reporting on financial data across OXXO's operations. There don't appear to be any known joins with this table in the catalog. Here are some questions you might be able to answer with this table alone: - What are the different types of financial statements tracked in this table? - How many financial statements are associated with each company, business unit, or consolidated entity? - What is the date range for which financial statement data is available in this table? - Which users or systems are updating the financial statement data in this table?
